summary: Dell Alienware X17 R1 System State Baseline
intent: Analyze system state baseline for Dell Alienware X17 R1
detected_fault: Frequent black screens, particularly when charging or after battery level drops below 50%
suggested_solution: Update BIOS firmware to latest version
Restore all settings to default factory settings in the BIOS
Disable Power on Lid Open, USB Power Share, and Advanced Optimus in the BIOS
Ensure all Intel drivers and Nvidia drivers are up-to-date
Uninstall AWCC and OC Controls from Control Panel
